stem.text: A rubber band is stretched and then relaxed to its original length. The diagram shows the force-extension graph for this process.

stem.alt: Force against extension graph: a curve OPQ rising from the origin O to a point Q at extension e, and a lower return curve QRO; arrows show the direction of each path; the regions labelled area X (between the two curves) and area Y (under the return curve) are shaded.

stem.text: As the force is increased, the curve follows the path OPQ to extension $e$. As the force is reduced, the curve follows the path QRO to return to zero extension.
The area labelled X is between the curves OPQ and QRO. The area labelled Y is bounded by the curve QRO and the horizontal axis.
Which statement about the process is correct?

A.text: Area X is the energy which heats the band as it is stretched to extension $e$.

B.text: (Area X + area Y) is the minimum energy required to stretch the band to extension $e$.

C.text: Area X is the elastic potential energy stored in the band when it is stretched to extension $e$.

D.text: (Area Y – area X) is the net work done on the band during the process.
